releaseTitle: DocuEdit Pro v10.8.2 (Seamless 1-Click Update & Forensic Perfection)
changelog:
⚡ Seamless 1-Click AutoUpdate & Forensic Camera Engine Perfection:
• Complete Underlying Text Erasure: Dual-engine Navier-Stokes & Telea full-box inpainting obliterates original text with zero ghosting or double text.
